room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy with attached washroom, excludes suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals as per policy wording.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Optional voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available for premium discount. 20% co-pay applies on reimbursement claims if optional 'Cashless Discount' cover is opted.

sub_limits.note: Inbuilt cataract sub-limit: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional 'Procedure/Disease Sub-limit' cover adds caps on cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, gall bladder, spine, cancer, kidney, liver, infectious conditions.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible. Optional voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹10,000–₹3,00,000 available for premium discount.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents covered from day 1.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required. Reducible via portability/migration credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, calculi, organ transplant, hysterectomy, arthroplasty, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at same rate on claim. Optional 'Super Cumulative Bonus' add-on offers up to 200% at 25%/yr or 50%/yr.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Options: once per policy year or unlimited times per policy year. Not available for organ donor or modern treatment claims. Subsequent hospitalisation must be after 2-day gap (same insured).

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list provided in Annexure I; other procedures qualifying under day-care definition also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI if patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available, must exceed 3 days. Several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, vector-borne, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation (min 24 hrs) covered up to In-patient SI. Outpatient and comfort treatments excluded.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered up to SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered. Restoration benefit not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to In-patient Hospitalisation SI; payable when life-threatening emergency certified by doctor and in-patient claim admitted.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, intra-vitreal injections, stem cell for haematological conditions, etc.) covered up to SI. Cumulative Bonus and Restoration not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables listed in Annexure II are excluded. Medical consumables used during treatment are covered as part of hospitalisation.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except for fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual premium; 15 days for monthly premium mode.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period at inception only; not applicable at renewal or porting.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, maternity excluded, no OPD, no infertility/IVF, no cosmetic surgery, no external medical equipment at home

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus, Disease Sub-limits, No Claim Discount, Cashless Discount, Accidental Death Cover
